sources.summary: YunTuo, Diageo's first single malt whisky distillery in China, is in the fertile Dali valley of Yunnan Province, at an altitude of approximately 2,100 metres and adjacent to the natural water source of Sanye Spring. Designed by OLI Architecture, the distillery translates its mountain setting, local craft traditions and whisky-making programme into a contemporary architectural experience rooted in place.
